trait.name: Psionic Mind
trait.description: You can communicate a telepathic message to one creature you can see within 30 feet. It understands the message if it understands at least one language, whether or not you share a language. This sends a message only: it does not read thoughts or grant the recipient a telepathic reply.

trait.name: Gem Flight
trait.description: Starting at character level 5, you can use a Bonus Action on your turn to manifest spectral wings for 1 minute. While they last, you gain a flying speed equal to your current walking speed and can hover. You can use this trait once per Long Rest; it is independent of your Breath Weapon.
